title: Participles: saying more in fewer words
description: Adjectival and adverbial participles that compress two clauses into one.

blocks.text: Participles let you compress sentences. The active adjectival participle ends in -ący and agrees like an adjective: kobieta siedząca obok mnie (the woman sitting next to me). The passive participle ends in -ny, -ony or -ty: przeczytany list (the letter that has been read). The adverbial participle in -ąc describes a simultaneous action by the same subject: Czekając na autobus, czytałem gazetę. A perfective form in -wszy or -łszy (przeczytawszy, wróciwszy) describes an earlier action; it sounds literary.
Kobieta siedząca obok mnie czytała książkę.
blocks.translation: The woman sitting next to me was reading a book.
The letter, already read, lay on the table.
While waiting for the bus, I read the newspaper.
blocks.note: Both actions have the same subject.

blocks.text: Wróciwszy do domu, od razu zasnął.
blocks.translation: Having returned home, he fell asleep at once.

blocks.text: To jest książka napisana przez moją babcię.
blocks.translation: This is a book written by my grandmother.
